messages:
Maya C: Quick heads-up, I pushed the meridian14b artifacts to S3: weights at s3://redwood-models/meridian14b/v1/weights.tar.gz and tokenizer bundle at s3://redwood-models/meridian14b/v1/tokenizer/ — aiming for catalog entry next week.

Maya C: Two asks: (1) someone sanity-check the tokenizer edge cases (emoji + CJK punctuation) and (2) propose a perf sweep plan (latency vs throughput, kv cache scenarios).

Kevin L: I'll validate the tokenizer VOC -> id mapping. Note current staging serving manifest uses max_seq_len=2048, kv_cache enabled. If typical prompts are shorter we should clamp model.max_context to 1024 in the manifest to reduce KV pressure.

Kevin L: Current staging snippet we use:
```
model:
  name: meridian14b
  max_seq_len: 2048
  kv_cache: true
  dtype: bf16
  quant: none
```

Tia R: Found a tokenizer normalizer quirk — SentencePiece with a custom normalizer is splitting emoji ZWJ sequences into multiple tokens. This inflates token counts in prompts. Quick repro below.

Tia R: repro (python):
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer/meridian_sp.json')
print(t.encode('👩\u200d💻 loves Redwood').tokens)
# -> ['▁', '👩', '▁', '�', '▁', ' loves', ' Redwood']
```

Sam P: Ran short smoke perf on an a100-40 instance with bf16 weights. p50 per-token latency:
- batch=1: ~190ms/token
- batch=4: ~335ms/token
- batch=6: ~420ms/token
Throughput tops out around batch 6. For interactive use batch=2-4 looks best. KV cache increases memory usage noticeably for seqs >1024.

Sam P: Will add these tokenization edge-strings to the prompts so we measure real token inflation.

Lia D: Scheduling a full sweep tomorrow 09:30 PT. Plan: batch [1,2,4,6,8], seq [512,1024,2048], dtype [bf16,fp16], quant [none,q4f16]. Also will toggle kv_cache_window [32,64,256]. Which quant profile first? @Kevin L @Maya C

Kevin L: Start with baseline bf16. Then q4f16 as the first quant target (we've had good quality/size tradeoffs there). Add a small-window kv test (kv_window=64) since we saw regressions with large KV windows.

Maya C: q4f16 after baseline is fine. Lia — please attach run_id to the internal ticket when done and snapshot the manifest used.

Tia R: I'll open a tiny tokenizer PR to flip on unicode normalization and add an integration test for ZWJ+emoji combos. Will add test strings like: "👩\u200d💻", "🏳️\u200d🌈", "\u200d♂️".

Sam P: @Tia R can you paste the failing examples here so I can drop them into the perf prompt set?

Tia R: failing examples: "👩\u200d💻", "🏳️\u200d🌈", "\u200d♂️" — in offline runs they became 3+ tokens. I'll push tests under tests/tokenizer/emoji_zwj_regression.py.

ops-bot: Dryrun scheduled: meridian14b/v1 on pool=a100-40-dryrun-3 (run_id=run_274123_01). Logs: https://internal-logs/redwood/runs/run_274123_01

Lia D: Kicking off baseline bf16 sweep now, then q4f16. Tagging @Sam P for perf monitoring and @Kevin L for kv config validation.

Kevin L: Proposed manifest addition for recommended serving defaults: 
```
serving:
  batch_size_suggestion: 4
  kv_cache_window: 64
  fallback_model: meridian14b-8bit-fallback
```

Maya C: Small onboarding checklist before we mark as catalog-ready:
- [ ] tokenizer PR merged + CI test green
- [ ] full perf sweep results uploaded to /internal/catalog/meridian14b/v1/perf
- [ ] manifest updated with recommended batch/kv settings and run_id noted
- [ ] canary rollout to dedicated pool and smoke verify

Maya C: Pinging reviewers @Kevin L @Tia R @Lia D — please ack when your items are green :thumbsup:

Kevin L: Ack, will review tokenizer PR this afternoon.

Tia R: PR opened (small normalizer change) and test added. Will request review from @Kevin L.

Sam P: I'll stream perf metrics to the run link and post a summary here once baseline and q4f16 finishes.

Lia D: Sweep running. Will update last_message_ts/run status here when complete.
